newsitem.title: USA: Dole Food stock falls after CFO resigns.
newsitem.headline: Dole Food stock falls after CFO resigns.

text.p: Shares of Dole Food Co Inc dropped five percent on Tuesday after a leading investment bank warned that the food company's earnings will become more difficult to forecast after the departure of Chief Financial Officer Michael Karsner.
Michael Branca of Lehman Brothers cut his recommendation on the stock to neutral from buy, though he maintained his earnings per share estimates.
"It's a question of predictability and valuation," Branca said.
Shares of Dole were off 2 to 37-3/4 in late trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
On Friday Dole said its third-quarter earnings will come in at the low end of analysts' estimates.
Earlier Tuesday, Dole said Karsner resigned to become chief financial officer of Republic Industries Inc.
Dole responded to Branca's concerns by saying the company would keep lines of communications to investors open.
"There has been no fundamental change in our business or how we plan to communiicate with Wall Street," said Tom Pernice, a spokesman for Dole.
He said Karsner left Dole because of an attractive offer from Republic rather than any internal disputes at Dole. Karsner could not be reached for comment.
Branca credited Karsner with improving communications with Wall Street and investors. Without him, the stock would be more difficult to value, the analyst said.

"While we are maintaining our earnings per share forecast, we now expect this stock to trade at a less prominent valuation, reflecting potentially ineffective near-term financial communications, increased uncertainty and less predictable profits," Branca said.
Nomi Ghez, an analyst at Goldman Sachs & Co, viewed the drop in the food company's share price as reason to intitate coverage with a buy recommendation.
"I don't think that the chief financial officer's departure is a fundamental issue. I thought the stock was overreacting," she said.
"They promise to keep channels of communications widely open, and as a first indication of that they intend to hold an investor conference call tommorrow," she added.
